question: Is it possible to convert a cloze-style questions to a naturally-looking questions?
title: Simple and Effective Semi-Supervised Question Answering
answer_rationale: The retrieved documents indicate that cloze-style questions can be automatically constructed from base documents and then fine-tuned to produce naturally-looking questions. Specifically, Text 1 and Text 3 describe systems that generate cloze-style questions from base documents and use them for pre-training and fine-tuning, which implies a transformation into naturally-looking questions. Text 2 further supports this by discussing the use of automatically constructed datasets for transfer learning, which can result in more natural question forms.
